description: This file contains shell script code that serves as a set of tests for Git command behaviors related to untracked files during operations like reset, checkout, rebase, stash, and am. It defines various setup functions and multiple test cases to verify proper handling of untracked files under different Git operations.

methods.name: test_setup_reset
methods.description: Initializes a Git repository, creates branches, and commits initial files to set up test scenarios for reset operations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of the enclosed commands.

methods.name: test_setup_checkout_m
methods.description: Initializes a repository and commits files to test checkout with untracked files.

methods.name: test_setup_sequencing
methods.description: Sets up a repository with commits and branches for testing rebase and related operations.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting failure of the enclosed commands.
